weather.source: REMS daily reports, Curiosity (Spain: Centro de Astrobiología / INTA; NASA/JPL-Caltech credit)

by_season.air_temp_min_c_method: Minimum of daily REMS air-temperature minima (°C) in this 30° Ls bin; overlapping public daily reports.
by_season.air_temp_max_c_method: Maximum of daily REMS air-temperature maxima (°C) in this 30° Ls bin; overlapping public daily reports.
by_season.pressure_pa_method: Arithmetic mean of daily mean REMS pressure (Pa) in this 30° Ls bin.
by_season.uv_method: No UV field is published in the daily report series used; category is unknown rather than inferred.
by_season.n_sols_method: Count of distinct terrestrial-date daily reports with Ls, air-temperature min/max and pressure.

latest.air_temp_min_c_method: Latest available daily REMS minimum air temperature (°C).
latest.air_temp_max_c_method: Latest available daily REMS maximum air temperature (°C).
latest.pressure_pa_method: Latest available daily REMS mean pressure (Pa).
latest.sol_method: Estimated from terrestrial date since Curiosity sol 1 using 1.02749125 Earth days per Martian sol.

radiation.surface_dose_mgy_per_day_method: Median of 2806 per-sol mean filtered RAD E-dose rates; each mean uses the filtered-dose column in µGy/day, converted to mGy/day. Elevated rate is the highest per-sol mean in the same record series.
radiation.solar_event_mgy_per_day_method: 99th percentile of the unfiltered RAD dose-rate column; data-derived elevated proxy, not an event-specific reconstruction. Median of 2806 per-sol mean filtered RAD E-dose rates; each mean uses the filtered-dose column in µGy/day, converted to mGy/day. Elevated rate is the highest per-sol mean in the same record series.
radiation.note: Measured at Gale. Filtered baseline and elevated unfiltered tail are RAD-derived proxies.

dust.source: Mars Climate Database dust climatology (Montabone et al.)

by_season.opacity_method: Mean local-surface column dust optical depth (cdodtot), nearest 2° Montabone climatology grid cell to Gale, pooled over available Mars years and Ls samples in this bin.
by_season.storm_fraction_method: Fraction of available climatology Ls samples in this bin with local-surface CDOD ≥ 1.0; operational threshold stated here as the storm proxy.
